newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price--USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price--USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Tuesday that around 1,000 head were exported into the United States at one crossing point Monday.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold at firm prices for steer calves. "Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices were 86-96 cents/lb for head weighing 300-400 lbs and for 400-500-lb head they were 78-86 cents/lb.
